title: Enterprise Connectivity: incident registration
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs incident registration for operational incident.

## Policy clause 1
Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and availability percentage from the official operational report.

## Policy clause 2
No customer statement substitutes for the report.

## Policy clause 3
Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage credit rules excludes them.

## Policy clause 4
Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Points of judgement
Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the excluded incident causes, availability target percentage used by this rule.

## Record identity: operational incident
Operations record a closed incident and its measured availability impact. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, source classification.
